scripts.build: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.4 --activate && pnpm --dir ghostmark install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline && pnpm --dir ghostmark build
scripts.start: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.4 --activate && pnpm --dir ghostmark start
scripts.dev: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@9.15.4 --activate && pnpm --dir ghostmark dev
scripts.build:storefront: COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@4.6.0 --activate && yarn --cwd ghostmark-storefront install --immutable && yarn --cwd ghostmark-storefront build
scripts.start:storefront: COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0 corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@4.6.0 --activate && yarn --cwd ghostmark-storefront start
scripts.cms:dev: pnpm --filter ./cms dev || (cd cms && npm run dev)
scripts.cms:build: pnpm --filter ./cms build || (cd cms && npm run build)
